sentence_stem: Had the author revised the final chapter,
correct_completion: the novel would have ended very differently.
full_sentence: Had the author revised the final chapter, the novel would have ended very differently.
acceptable_variants: the ending would have changed completely.
the story would have taken another direction.

options.text: the novel ends very differently now.
options.why_wrong: The present simple does not complete an inverted third conditional, which refers to a past revision and its imagined past result.

options.text: the novel to end very differently.
options.why_wrong: A bare infinitive cannot form the main clause after inverted 'Had'; a modal verb phrase is needed.

options.text: the novel would have ended very differently.
the novel was ending very differently.
options.why_wrong: The past progressive describes an action in progress and does not express the hypothetical result of an unrealized past event.

explanation: Inversion replaces 'if' with the auxiliary 'had' at the start of the clause. The main clause then uses 'would have' plus a past participle to express an imagined past result.
translation: Si el autor hubiera revisado el último capítulo, la novela habría terminado de manera muy diferente.
